input: Interview three wedding photographers this month

gold.taskTitle: Interview Three Wedding Photographers This Month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to interview three wedding photographers within the current month to find a suitable candidate for their wedding.

questions.title: What is the exact date of your wedding?
questions.description: Knowing the wedding date helps identify photographers who are available and experienced with similar timelines.

questions.title: Do you already have specific photographers in mind?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user has candidates identified or needs to find them from scratch shapes the first steps of the plan.

questions.title: What is your total budget for wedding photography?
questions.description: Budget is a key filter when shortlisting and comparing photographers during interviews.

questions.title: Will interviews be in person, by video call, or phone?
questions.description: The format of the interview affects scheduling, preparation, and what materials to have ready.

questions.title: What photography style are you looking for?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred style, such as documentary, portrait, or fine art, helps evaluate whether each photographer is a good fit.

questions.title: How many hours of coverage do you need on the day?
questions.description: Coverage duration affects pricing, package comparison, and the specific questions to ask each photographer.

questions.title: By what date do you need to make a final decision?
questions.description: A decision deadline helps work backward to schedule all three interviews within the month with enough time to compare and decide.
